P1.1.text: Protolabs | Rapid Prototyping & On-demand Production Services

P1.2.text: Protolabs is your custom manufacturing resource from rapid prototyping to end-use production. Get an interactive quote with free design analysis within hours for parts in days.

P1.3.text: Check out our Periodic Table of Materials for a quick snapshot of plastic and metal materials at Protolabs! | Explore Materials arrow_right_alt

P1.4.text: Digital Manufacturing for Early Prototyping to Final Production

P1.5.text: We are the fastest and most comprehensive manufacturer in the world. Get an online quote for parts within days or talk with a production expert for solutions across your entire product life cycle

P1.6.text: Get Instant Quote Start Production Quote

P1.7.text: Certification + Compliance ISO 9001:2015 | ISO 13485:2016 | AS9100D | ITAR

P1.8.text: Get affordable, high-quality molded parts and bridge tooling within days. With our free moldability consultation, the design and molding process is rapidly accelerated to save you time and money.

P1.9.text: Low-volume molding up to 100,000+ parts with volume pricing available—no MOQ required

P1.10.text: 100+ plastic, elastomeric, and silicone rubber materials

P1.11.text: Automated CMM for fast, in-house quality documentation

P1.12.text: Leverage the same speed, precision, and reliability in machining that you’re accustomed to at Protolabs but unlock advanced machining capabilities like tighter tolerances and volume pricing through our manufacturing network.

P1.13.text: Machined parts in as fast as 1 day with optional plating and anodizing in as fast as 4 days

P1.14.text: Cost-efficient machined parts at higher volumes

P1.15.text: Tolerances down to ±0.001 in. (0.020mm) through our digital network

P1.16.text: Choose from seven different additive manufacturing technologies for cost-effective prototyping and highly precise, repeatable production parts.

P1.17.text: Additive technologies include metal 3D printing, SLA, SLS, FDM, and more

P1.18.text: 30 plastic and metal materials in a range of finishes

P1.21.text: From easy quoting to quick-turn production and finishing options, get up to 500 quality sheet metal parts in your hands in days from a single supplier.

P1.22.text: Instant quotes with interactive manufacturability feedback

P1.23.text: Six sheet metal materials including aluminum, stainless steel, steel, brass, and copper

P1.24.text: Finishing options from welding and hardware insertion to powder coating and silk screening

P1.25.text: Led by technology and backed by human support, our approach to production manufacturing can be tailored to your project, industry, budget and timeframe.

P1.26.text: 24 New CNC Materials Just Landed on Protolabs Network

P1.27.text: We’ve expanded our CNC machining range from 52 to 76 materials, which is a ~50% increase.

P1.28.text: The Next Wave of Manufacturing Innovation

P1.29.text: Explore how the latest digital technologies are transforming every stage of the product life cycle from early concept to end-of-life.

P1.30.text: Our enhanced digital platform for quoting, ordering, and managing custom parts. Get real-time pricing and AI-enabled DFM feedback, with easy options to configure materials and lead times. ProDesk helps your team stay aligned and move faster from prototype to production.

P1.31.text: Get parts delivered in as fast as 4 days with our expanded CNC milling services—now accepting 2D technical drawings for greater flexibility on higher‑requirement projects.

P1.32.text: A Trusted Partner for Full-Scale Production

P1.33.text: Our team is ready to help you get your production project started with help from our experts at every step of the process.

P1.34.text: Two new materials, Ceramic-filled and Tough Black, have been added to our material library alongside our newly launched HPS 3D printing process.

P1.35.text: Our critical-to-quality inspections are now easily configured within your injection molding quote. We also provide a range of additional quality documentation.

P1.36.text: New Material Tool for Injection Molding

P1.37.text: Compare materials for injection molding with our new tool. Sort by material type, attributes, flame rating, and color to find the right material for your project.

P1.2.text: UFP Technologies is the trusted design, development, engineering, and manufacturing partner to turn your vision into a reality through best-in-class comprehensive solutions primarily for medical devices and sterile packaging, as well as other highly engineered custom products.

P1.3.text: MedTech evolves at breathtaking speeds. To keep pace, you need forward-thinking collaboration to develop your idea and anticipate the challenges at each phase of the process. UFP MedTech is the ideal partner to help you accelerate single-use and single patient devices from development through launch and manufacturing.

P1.4.text: For aerospace, defense, automotive, and other highly engineered components and packaging, our advanced engineering capabilities and materials expertise ensures optimal designs and seamless implementation to make your vision a reality.

P1.6.text: Trust UFP Technologies to turn your vision into reality with best-in-class comprehensive solutions based on our vast depth of engineering expertise. Our nimble and dynamic team will work with you to create custom designs from foams, films, plastics, nonwovens, fabrics, and other specialty materials. All with the ultimate goal of positioning your ideas for success.

P1.7.text: From the initial stages of development, we review your project from every angle, assigning a dedicated team to fully understand the unique needs and potential challenges before we start.

P1.8.text: We act as an extension of your R&D and engineering teams, applying our vast materials expertise and design skills, so that each decision we make is optimized for the application.

P1.9.text: We understand the importance of delivering sound engineering and rapid prototypes. Our in-house tooling capabilities and custom equipment allow us to execute quickly and accurately, producing prototypes within 72 hours.

P1.10.text: Mitigating any potential risks through quality management systems ensures a seamless transition from prototype to full-scale production.

P1.11.text: Our turnkey solutions include high volume manufacturing, packaging, and supply chain management through multiple global locations to get your product to market quickly and efficiently.

P2.2.text: We strive to be our customers’ design, engineering and manufacturing partner, entrusted to turn their vision into reality through best-in-class comprehensive solutions for medical devices, packaging, components and products.

P2.3.text: and headquartered in Newburyport, Massachusetts, UFP Technologies is a contract development and manufacturing organization that specializes in single-use and single-patient medical devices. UFP is an important link in the medical device supply chain and a valued outsource partner to many of the top medical device manufacturers in the world. Our single-use and single-patient devices and components are used in a wide range of medical devices and packaging for minimally invasive surgery, infection prevention, wound care, wearables, orthopedic soft goods, and orthopedic implants.
